questions.q: What does the Seven Levels Deep exercise involve?
a: Asking yourself why seven times in a row
Writing down seven goals for the year
Reviewing seven habits every morning
Listing seven people who inspire you
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the exercise is simply asking yourself the question why, seven times.

questions.q: Why does knowing your deeper why matter when hard days arrive?
a: It helps you keep going instead of giving up
It makes other people trust you more
It removes the need for a business plan
It guarantees quick financial results
questions.why: Lesson 1 calls your why a defense against abandoning your dreams when things get difficult.

questions.q: What does the summary say happens when you focus on your strengths?
a: You become happier and your weaknesses matter less
Your weaknesses quietly turn into strengths
You stop needing feedback from other people
You avoid having to learn anything new
questions.why: Lesson 2 says working on strengths brings happiness and that weaknesses take care of themselves.

questions.q: What first step does the summary suggest for living within your strengths?
a: Ask people close to you what you are good at
Take a test that ranks your weaknesses
Copy the habits of a successful mentor
Set a goal to fix one flaw each month
questions.why: Lesson 2 advises asking those closest to you, then making a list and a plan.

questions.q: How did Carol awaken her inner hero, according to the summary?
a: She focused on solutions instead of what was wrong
She blamed the economy for her troubles
She waited for better circumstances to arrive
She borrowed money from her family
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the hero focuses on solutions rather than dwelling on everything that is wrong.
